# Effect of treatment over time

\## The data

```{r s22-load-data}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

prepost <- read.csv(here("data", "PrePost.csv"))
str(prepost)
summary(prepost)
table(prepost$time)
```

The file `PrePost.csv` contains 16 observations and 2 variables: a performance measure (`perf`) and the time of measurement (`time`), with 8 measurements before and 8 measurements after the rehabilitation program.

No variable identifies the participants, so the file itself does not tell us whether the same individuals were measured before and after.

| Variable | Description | Unit | Possible values | Expected change |
|-------|---------------|---------------|--------------|---------------|
| Perf | Physical performance of cardiac patients, measured before and after a rehabilitation training program | Not specified (possibly watts on a cycle ergometer) | Positive values; observed range 125–148 | Increase after rehabilitation |
| time | Moment of the measurement | – | "Before", "After" | – |
